reviews.reason: handleSave awaits AntD form.validateFields before checking selectedTarget. The diagnostic correctly observes that the missing-pricing early return does not consume values; the current ordering nevertheless publishes base-field validation feedback before pricing feedback. Moving the await below that guard changes the observable validation order instead of being a mechanical scheduling-only rewrite. Retain this source-bound UI-order preservation decision; it is not evidence that the pricing guard depends on the validated values or that a product failure exists.

The named owner and extracted child/controller boundaries below explain this component; declaration length alone is not a demonstrated competing responsibility or behavior failure. ModelProviderInstanceDrawerContent retains editable config/secret/model/authentication drafts, with initializedDrawerRef guarded by mode/installation/instance drawerIdentity. It initializes once per identity and resets all credential/preview state when closed or switching owner; query object refresh for the same identity does not reset unsaved edits. Configured model rows and auth/cached catalog receipts remain separate state axes with dedicated child modals/cards. Reassessed 2026-11-03: Instance create/update and validate/preview consume exact operations; config, secret, cached-model and authentication children retain the same identity-scoped draft controller.

The flagged render-prefixed function is invoked normally; React does not treat that call as a new component type. ModelProviderInstanceDrawer invokes renderAuthenticationCard() as an ordinary function to fill its authentication slot. It does not render <RenderAuthenticationCard/> or create a new component type, so no remount follows from the render-prefixed name. Reassessed 2026-11-03: Instance create/update and validate/preview consume exact operations; config, secret, cached-model and authentication children retain the same identity-scoped draft controller.

The flagged empty option is disabled and hidden as the select placeholder sentinel. The enclosing select has an aria-label; the sentinel is not an independently operable unlabeled control. Reassessed 2026-11-03: Main-instance updates consume their exact operation while source-instance inspection stays available. The disabled hidden placeholder sentinel still belongs to an aria-labelled select.

Direct render helpers keep stable returned element types/keys.
